signature: SUBROUTINE DGEBAL( JOB, N, A, LDA, ILO, IHI, SCALE, INFO )

params.name: job
N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the input matrix A. On exit, A is overwritten by the balanced matrix. If `JOB = 'N'`, A is not referenced. See Further Details.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: ihi
params.reference: `ILO` and `IHI` are set to integers such that on exit $A(i,j) = 0$ if $i > j$ and $j = 1$,...,`ILO`-1 or $I = \mathrm{IHI}+1$,...,N. If `JOB = 'N'` or 'S', `ILO = 1` and `IHI = N`.

params.name: SCALE
params.reference:
Details of the permutations and scaling factors applied to A. If P(j) is the index of the row and column interchanged with row and column j and D(j) is the scaling factor applied to row and column j, then

```text
SCALE(j) = P(j)    for j = 1,...,ILO-1
         = D(j)    for j = ILO,...,IHI
         = P(j)    for j = IHI+1,...,N.
```

The order in which the interchanges are made is N to `IHI`+1, then 1 to `ILO`-1.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit.
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
